description.value:
Great Fireball Technique. The signature jutsu of the Uchiha clan. You exhale a massive ball of flame that detonates at a point you choose within range, dealing 3d6 fire damage in a 10-foot burst. Each creature in the area attempts a basic Reflex save.

The fire is wide enough to ignite flammable objects in the area (clothing, oil, dry brush) and to leave a 1-round residual flame in the burst's central square.

Heightened (+1) Damage increases by 1d6.
